mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a cross between two different lines (varieties, strains) that differ in two observed traits."
Dihybrid cross is a cross between two different lines (varieties, strains) that differ in two observed traits.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the efforts of man to increase the frequency of desirable genes in his herd."
Artificial selection is the efforts of man to increase the frequency of desirable genes in his herd.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the tip of the chromosome, each consisting of many repeats of the sequence TTAGGG that are whittled down with each mitotic cell division."
The telomeres are the tip of the chromosome, each consisting of many repeats of the sequence TTAGGG that are whittled down with each mitotic cell division.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a designation that is broader than the familiar kingdom."
A domain is a designation that is broader than the familiar kingdom.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same as mating systems."
Breeding methods is the same as mating systems.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a situation where the individual possesses extra fingers or toes and such a condition is due to: (a) lethality (b) variable expressivity (c) incomplete penetrance 5."
Polydactyl in man is a situation where the individual possesses extra fingers or toes and such a condition is due to: (a) lethality (b) variable expressivity (c) incomplete penetrance 5.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a chemical compound comprising three components: a nitrogen- containing base, a pentose (five-carbon) sugar, and one or more phosphate groups."
A nucleotide is a chemical compound comprising three components: a nitrogen- containing base, a pentose (five-carbon) sugar, and one or more phosphate groups.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the largest constriction of a chromosome and where spindle fibres attach."
The centromere is the largest constriction of a chromosome and where spindle fibres attach.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the application of the principles of animal genetics for the improvement of economically important characteristics (traits) in domestic animals."
Animal breeding refers to the application of the principles of animal genetics for the improvement of economically important characteristics (traits) in domestic animals.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of science concerned with development and utilization of DNA sequences and genetic maps that represent the architecture of the genome."
Genomics is a branch of science concerned with development and utilization of DNA sequences and genetic maps that represent the architecture of the genome.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the 3rd nucleotide in a codon."
Wobble position of a codon refers to the 3rd nucleotide in a codon.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used when the trait of interest cannot be measured in the individual animal."
The system is used when the trait of interest cannot be measured in the individual animal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those related to reproductive fitness."
Characters with lowest heritability are those related to reproductive fitness.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called dominant gene while the lowercase (r) is known as a recessive allele."
The uppercase (R) is called dominant gene while the lowercase (r) is known as a recessive allele.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the influence of the environment on the survival and reproductive ability of an individual."
Natural selection is the influence of the environment on the survival and reproductive ability of an individual.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an autosomal recessive disorder in which affected individuals produce abnormal form of haemoglobin."
The sickle cell trait is an autosomal recessive disorder in which affected individuals produce abnormal form of haemoglobin.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a situation where some traits occur in only one of the sexes e.g. breast development in mammals."
Sex-limited inheritance is a situation where some traits occur in only one of the sexes e.g. breast development in mammals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a condition in which both alleles for the same gene are fully expressed."
Codominance is a condition in which both alleles for the same gene are fully expressed.
